scenes.hook: C S S Flexbox in 60 Seconds. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Flexbox arranges items along one main axis. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.

scenes.tip: Justify content controls the main axis; align items controls the cross axis. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
